title: UV-Vis Spectrum Studio
description: UV-Vis Spectrum Studio is an open-source, cross-platform scientific environment for UV-Vis spectroscopy. It provides spectral import and cleaning, publication-quality visualization, derivative spectroscopy through fourth order with quality safeguards, quantitative calibration and analytical-method validation, multicomponent spectrophotometry, peak fitting and deconvolution, Fourier and wavelet analysis, chemometrics with fold-safe preprocessing and nested PLS validation, and reproducible tamper-evident project archives. Desktop distributions are produced for Windows, macOS, and Linux from the same tested scientific core.
notes: Research and analytical-support software released under the MIT License. The software is not represented as a validated GMP, GLP, 21 CFR Part 11, or ISO 17025 system by default. Laboratories remain responsible for method validation, software qualification, and data-integrity controls required by their quality system. Release assets include platform-specific builds, checksums, and dependency snapshots where produced by CI.
